description: baseline: carry forward best may21 arch (MAE loss)
Exp1: differential LR splitter - splitter format bug corrupted backbone
Exp2: backbone fine-tune LR=3e-3 - backbone in train mode breaks BatchNorm
Exp3: backbone fine-tune eval-mode LR=1e-3 - NaN gradient explosion
Exp4: attention pooling replaces max (mean+attn+std per layer)
Exp5: dual attention heads per layer (mean+attn1+attn2, replaces std)
Exp6: lag-1..5 autocorrelation features - worse, backbone already captures correlations
Exp7: mean+max+attn per layer - worse, max inferior to second attn head
Exp8: residual block in head (ResBlock(512) skip connection)
Exp9: two residual blocks - worse, ran out of training steps in 5 min
Exp10: mean+attn+std+ResBlock - std is worse than second attn head
Exp11: bottleneck ResBlock 512->256->512 - worse than wide ResBlock
Exp12: second-half mean replaces attn2 - worse overall and mae_10_50
Exp13: LR_MAX=2e-2 - too high, slower convergence
Exp14: triple attn heads (8193-dim) - too many params to converge in 5 min
Exp15: explicit physics features (mean_dr/std_dr/cos/abs_dth) - already in backbone
Exp16: EPOCHS=10 - only uses 233s budget, wastes 67s compute
Exp17: wd=1e-4 - less reg hurts, wd=1e-3 is better
Exp18: per-layer attn temperature (4 scalars) - adds noise
Exp19: bs=128 - fewer gradient steps, worse convergence
Exp20: bs=32 - too noisy, bs=64 is optimal
Exp21: last-layer-only pooling - all 4 layers are needed
Exp22: 2x oversample short trajs - biases model, hurts all ranges
Exp23: transformer head (cross-vector attention) - underfits in 5 min
Exp24: checkpoint warm-start - cold start worse than Exp8 due to random split variance
Exp25: two-phase LR (1e-2 then 3e-3) - single fit_one_cycle is better
Exp26: ResBlock(256) added after first ResBlock(512) - ran out of budget
Exp27: remove dead code + freeze_backbone=True - no real improvement
Exp28: sigmoid output scaling sigma*2.2-0.1 - worse, sigmoid compresses gradients near edges
Exp29: fp16 mixed precision - NaN, transformer softmax overflows in fp16
Exp30: two-phase training short-traj fine-tune - biases model, hurts long trajs
Exp31: dropout=0.1 on pooled features - worse, dropout hurts pretrained features
Exp32: multi-cycle LR restarts 3x5 epochs - short cycles hurt convergence
Exp33: fine-tune last backbone layer LR=1e-5 - improved mae_10_50 but hurt long trajs
Exp34: cross-layer attention pool 512 extra features - extra params slow convergence
Exp35: attn pools as deviation from mean - functionally equivalent, within noise
Exp36: length-conditioned attention append log(T) to tokens - worse
Exp37: output bias init to mean alpha=1.0 - no benefit, fit_one_cycle handles init
Exp38: time reversal augmentation - hurts (first dtheta artifact after reversal)
Exp39: SmoothL1Loss(beta=0.3) - train/eval metric mismatch hurts
Exp40: per-layer compress 1536->128 - loses cross-layer info, worse than direct
Exp41: FiLM conditioning log(T) scale+shift - no benefit over simple concat
Exp42: Mixup(alpha=0.2) - interpolated trajectories provide poor training signal
Exp43: wd=3e-3 - stronger wd hurts short trajs more
Exp44: val_frac=0.1 - smaller val set less representative, noisier estimate
Exp45: direct linear skip to output - gradient conflict between skip and head
Exp46: length-weighted loss sqrt(50/T) - distorted gradients hurt convergence
Exp47: gradient clip 1.0 - no benefit
Exp48: conv stem pooling as 5th source - too many extra params
Exp49: ResBlock(256) after compression - worse
Exp50: nonlinear attn query MLP 512->64->2 - too slow to converge
Exp51: narrow head 384 hidden dim - worse than 512
Exp52: skip first backbone layer (layers 1-3 only) - first layer matters
Exp53: learnable per-layer scale scalars - adds noise
Exp54: fixed seed=42 - unfavorable seed, worse than Exp8
Exp55: T-conditioned MoE short/long specialist heads - interpolation doesn't specialize
Exp56: learnable pos bias in attn queries - helps long trajs but hurts short ones
Exp57: length-scaled pos bias (0 at T=10, full at T=200) - worse across the board
Exp58: TTA mirror-reflect eval-only - backbone not orientation-invariant, hurts
Exp59: per-layer compress 1536->256 (1.9M params) - loses cross-layer info
Exp60: wider ResBlock 512->768->512 (+524K params) - too many params for 5min budget
Exp61: sigmoid attention pooling - worse than softmax (token competition helps)
Exp62: context-aware attn head2 - conditioning on head1 weights doesnt help diversity
